## Review and RLS audit of PR #46 (T-035, bugs of 17 Oct)

Reviewer and RLS-auditor subagents, each starting without the implementer's context, on `git diff origin/main...agent/claude/T-035-bugs-17-oct` at 7aea298. CI on head: `check` passed.

### Findings

| #   | Severity                 | Finding                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Resolution                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Blocking (found by both) | Group link takeover: tokens are chosen by the browser and nothing tied a `group_token` to one account, so an admin of another account who had seen a link could insert a row with `token` or `group_token` equal to it and catch the people opening it (they would join the other account). | Migration 0026 now adds trigger `invitations_token_guard` (definer, allowlisted): a group token belongs to one account and is never anyone's single token, and the other way round. Test "another account cannot take over a group link" plus the auditor's test. |
| 2   | High                     | The reset-password flag could trap a signed-out tab on "New password" for 30 minutes (sign-out didn't clear it; a used/expired link).                                                                                                                                                       | `RecoveryGuard` redirects only with a session, clears the flag otherwise and on `SIGNED_OUT`; "Back to sign in" clears it.                                                                                                                                        |
| 3   | High                     | "Create a new link" attached the renewed batch to whichever cottage was open.                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Renewal keeps the old rows' `property_id`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 4   | Medium                   | Batch email put every invitee in To.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Several people go in Bcc.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| 5   | Medium                   | The saved personal email (shared browser, 7 days, not cleared on sign-out) could be invited as admin by someone else's institution sign-up; the invite and overlap-answer failures were only logged.                                                                                        | Saved together with the typed work email and used only for that sign-in, for one day; both failures now show a message.                                                                                                                                           |
| 6   | Medium                   | Renewal created the new batch before revoking the old rows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Revoke first, then create.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 7   | Medium                   | A partial update of a batch reported success.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Reports "only n of m changed".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| 8   | Low                      | A group link shows masked hints for every invitee.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Left as is; product call (see questions).                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| 9   | Low                      | Any admin can convert to an organisation; free-email blocklist duplicates `src/lib/signup.ts`; `INSTITUTIONAL` plan comes free once billing limits are enforced (T-009).                                                                                                                    | Open: decide before T-009.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 10  | Low                      | Stale-chunk reload at most once a minute.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Acceptable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 11  | Low                      | PR Verification was a summary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Real output pasted in the PR.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

All new definer functions check the caller, search_path pinned, only `authenticated` executes them (`invitation_preview` already allowlisted for anon). Migration is idempotent and non-destructive (one data change: `overlap_allowed = true` where a guest limit is saved). Text through `t()`, 44px targets, Supabase errors handled.
